name: Sock Drawer Drift
title: Sock Drawer Drift

character.name: Nimbus
character.detail: mismatched button eyes and a single sock cape

joke: The drawer filed a missing-sock report and the lint showed up.
description: A round dust creature sprints an endless hallway of lonely furniture, gathering unmatched socks before the vacuum arrives. This daily parody game is about a silly household mystery and is made purely for entertainment.
